Supplier — Transactions

This screen displays all accounts payable transactions for a specific supplier, providing a complete history of your financial dealings with them.

The transactions shown include purchase invoices, debit notes, payments, and any journal entries that affect the supplier's balance.

Each transaction displays the date, reference number, description, and amount. The running balance column shows the cumulative amount owed to the supplier after each transaction.

You can click on any transaction to view its full details or make edits if needed.

For more information, see: Supplier — Edit
